caption: The drawing depicts a wooden statue of a man standing on a rectangular base inscribed with the text "COL. SELLERS." The figure wears a long dark brown coat, a mustard-yellow vest, a white shirt, and a tie, with one arm bent at the elbow and the hand raised above his head, while the other arm bends across his chest. The pants are a light tan color, distinct from the darker suit jacket and vest. The shoes are a muted gray. The base under the figure appears textured with a crisscross pattern and is shaded to indicate depth. The man’s face is elongated, with visible facial features including eyes, a nose, ears, and a mouth, and his head is tilted slightly to the right. The overall composition is centered within the plain, cream-colored background.
title: Medicine Man
